# OMA-AI

> One gateway. Every model. No lock-in. OpenAI-compatible AI inference with
> wallet-based auth and USDC pay-per-request on Base (x402). Privacy-first:
> zero data retention on prompt content. Self-hostable.

## Overview
- Product: https://oma-ai.com
- API base URL: `https://api.oma-ai.com/v1`
- OpenAI-compatible: drop-in for `openai-python`, `openai-node`, Vercel AI SDK,
  LangChain, raw `fetch`, and any HTTP client.
- Auth: SIWE wallet, account number, API keys, and per-request x402 payments.
- Brand: Open Model Access · accent `#46d39a` · void `#07090a`

## Documentation
- [Docs home](https://oma-ai.com/docs): full API reference
- [Model catalog](https://oma-ai.com/models): models, prices, capabilities
- [Pricing](https://oma-ai.com/pricing): per-token cost breakdown (+ FAQ)
- [Changelog](https://oma-ai.com/changelog): product updates
- [Network](https://oma-ai.com/network): provider / chain status
- [Privacy](https://oma-ai.com/privacy) · [Terms](https://oma-ai.com/terms)

## Endpoints
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | POST | Chat completions (streaming + tool calls) |
| `/v1/models` | GET | List available models and capabilities |
| `/v1/images/generations` | POST | Image generation |
| `/v1/videos/generations` | POST | Async video generation |
| `/v1/x402/quote` | POST | Get x402 payment quote for a request |
| `/v1/api-keys` | GET/POST/DELETE | Manage API keys |
| `/v1/balance` | GET | Credit balance |
| `/v1/health` | GET | Service and upstream provider health |

## Authentication
Three modes, all served by the same endpoints:

1. **API key** — `Authorization: Bearer $OMA_KEY`. Low-friction signup at
   [oma-ai.com/login](https://oma-ai.com/login).
2. **Wallet (SIWE)** — wallet-based session; no email required.
3. **x402 pay-per-request** — agent-native USDC settlement on Base. No
   pre-funded account required for single-shot agent calls.

## Pricing model
Pay-as-you-go credits denominated in USDC. Deposit USDC on Base, SOL via
cross-chain routes, or 20+ chains via HoudiniSwap. Per-model input/output
rates are listed on `/models` and `GET /v1/models`.
